summary.headline: Rossell Techsys posted record Q2 FY27 revenue of INR185.56 crore (+47% YoY) and first double-digit quarterly PBT at INR12.91 crore.
summary.overview: Management reported record quarterly revenue of INR185.56 crore, EBITDA of INR29 crore and PBT of INR12.91 crore for Q2 FY27, with H1 revenue of INR345 crore, EBITDA of INR52 crore and PBT of INR22.3 crore. The company completed a INR300 crore institutional capital raise (SBI MF and Kotak MF named) and onboarded a second global semiconductor equipment customer. Inventory holding improved to 6.67 months from 7.98 months a year earlier, and a leased facility of about 140,000 sq ft (expandable to 210,000 sq ft) is expected to start early next quarter. Management declined to give a numeric FY27 revenue guidance, pointing instead to stronger Q3 and Q4.

financial_highlights.change: Highest ever quarterly PBT; first time quarterly PBT crossed double digits
Around 60% growth per analyst framing; not separately quantified by management

segments.name: Aerospace & Defense
segments.commentary: Remains the core business; management said non-aerospace and defence was about INR130-140 crore of the INR345 crore H1 revenue, so aerospace is still the majority. Management said the split is not yet 50/50 but expects to reach it by year-end.

segments.name: Semiconductor and Space (non-A&D)
segments.commentary: Space and semiconductor revenue was about INR100 crore in FY26 and has already crossed INR140 crore in H1 FY27 per management. Company onboarded another global semiconductor equipment maker, so it now serves two large multinational semicon customers.

segments.name: MRO
segments.commentary: CEO said MRO capability is new and the company is in talks with large companies to be an MRO service partner in India, and is doing work for Boeing and other US companies on aftermarket service. Results are expected mainly in Q3 and Q4.

guidance_outlook: Management said it could not give exact FY27 revenue numbers, but expects sequential growth and a strong Q3 and Q4, which have historically been the best quarters.
Management expects growth to continue for at least 12-16 quarters, and semicon growth for at least three years.
EBITDA margin target of 18%-23%; management said the company is well on track, with Nisarg Shah citing a 17%-20% margin range from earlier calls.
Internal target to reach a four-month inventory holding (three-turn) within about 24 months.
Management expects a visible interest cost saving from Q3 FY27 after using INR300 crore raise proceeds to repay working capital limits; no quantum given beyond 'significant portion'.
Management said no further fundraise is planned in the near term.
capex_capacity: New leased facility in the Aerospace Park of about 140,000 sq ft, with an option to expand to 210,000 sq ft; expected to commence early next quarter (Q3 FY27).
Facility is intended to add manufacturing capacity for semicon and other non-defence sectors and create headroom for future wins.

INR300 crore capital raise: management said proceeds are a mix of balance sheet strengthening and debt repayment (working capital limits) plus growth, operational excellence and infrastructure investment.
Management said the raise is meant to fund growth over the next three years.
demand_pricing: Order book: confirmed POs of about INR910 crore to be executed over about 2.5 years; strategic agreements of over INR3,100 crore to be executed over five years.
H1 FY27 fresh orders about INR430 crore against bids of about INR1,350 crore submitted.
Demand drivers cited: global aerospace and defence spending, realignment of global supply chains, and semiconductor manufacturing investment.
Management gave no pricing or realisation data in the call.

qa_highlights.question: Are EBITDA margins on track toward the 17%-20% range guided earlier, and is there more room?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margins are improving and there is scope for more; the target is an 18%-23% EBITDA margin and the company is well on track.

qa_highlights.question: Is the revenue split between aerospace and non-aerospace near 50/50?
qa_highlights.answer: Not yet; of the INR345 crore H1 revenue, about INR130-140 crore was non-aerospace and defence. Management expects to reach 50/50 by year-end.

qa_highlights.question: What is FY27 revenue guidance, given the earlier 80%+ growth reference?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give numeric guidance, saying it cannot provide forward-looking outlook, but expects sequential growth with strong Q3 and Q4.

qa_highlights.question: How is the space and semicon segment doing against the 3x-4x growth goal?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is on track; space and semicon revenue was about INR100 crore last year and has crossed INR140 crore in the first two quarters of this year.

qa_highlights.question: Will the INR300 crore raise repay debt or fund growth, and how much interest cost will fall?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is a mix; a large part repays working capital limits, with interest savings expected from Q3. The quantum was not given; a CFO-side comment said a significant portion of interest cost would be saved and shown in Q3 results.

qa_highlights.question: What is the semicon pipeline and how is the MRO business progressing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it now serves two large multinational semicon customers and expects a larger share of revenue from semicon in Q3-Q4. On MRO, the CEO said talks are under way with large companies for India MRO partnerships and work for Boeing and other US companies is ongoing, with results expected in Q3-Q4.

risks_watch: No numeric FY27 guidance; sequential growth depends on Q3-Q4 execution, which management says is historically the strongest period.
Working capital: inventory still 6.67 months against a four-month internal target.
Interest cost savings from Q3 are unquantified; the call transcript records a person named Krishna answering, whose role is not identified.
Semicon and MRO ramps are early; revenue contribution not quantified beyond H1 non-A&D revenue.
Q3 FY27 watch items: interest cost reduction, new Aerospace Park facility start-up, and aerospace/non-aerospace mix trend.
Confirmed PO of INR910 crore against strategic agreements of over INR3,100 crore; the strategic agreements are not firm orders.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth, margins and semicon; cautious on forward numbers, as management declined to quantify FY27 revenue or the interest saving. Management also repeatedly stressed being 'mindful of challenges'.
key_quotes: The first half of the year 27 has been our strongest ever half-yearly performance, with robust growth across key financial and operational parameters.
In the second quarter, Rossell Techsys reported its highest ever quarterly revenue of INR185.56 crores, representing a growth of 47% over the corresponding quarter of the previous year.
We are particularly pleased and encouraged by the progress we are making in the semiconductor segment.
We believe we're still in the early stages of a much larger growth journey.

adds.what: Leased facility in Aerospace Park, about 140,000 sq ft (option to expand to 210,000 sq ft) for semicon and non-defence manufacturing

growth.why: Management gave no numeric FY27 revenue guidance but expects sequential growth and a strong Q3/Q4, backed by a confirmed INR910 crore PO over 2.5 years, a new ~140,000 sq ft leased facility starting next quarter, and second semicon customer onboarding; growth sustained for 12-16 quarters is guided but without numbers.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EBITDA of INR29 crore in Q2 FY27 and H1 EBITDA of INR52 crore on INR345 crore revenue (~15% margin), with management saying margins are improving toward the 18%-23% target and the company is well on track; interest savings from Q3 from repaying working capital limits add to PBT.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: A leased ~140,000 sq ft facility in the Aerospace Park (expandable to 210,000 sq ft) is under construction and expected to commence early Q3 FY27, adding manufacturing capacity for semicon and non-defence work.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management expects sequential growth with strong Q3 and Q4 (historically the best quarters), backed by confirmed POs of about INR910 crore over 2.5 years and H1 revenue of INR345 crore; no numeric guidance given.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: The INR300 crore raise is meant to fund growth over three years and the new facility has an expansion option to 210,000 sq ft, but no new capex quantum or date was announced and management said no further fundraise is planned near term.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management is confident on Q3-Q4 and semicon growth (space and semicon already above INR140 crore in H1 vs about INR100 crore in FY26), but declined to give numeric FY27 guidance, so an upgrade has no numeric anchor yet.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management reports record Q2 revenue of INR185.56 crore (+47% YoY) and first double-digit quarterly PBT, with fresh orders of about INR430 crore in H1 and confirmed POs of INR910 crore, so no cut is signalled, though inventory at 6.67 months versus a 4-month target is a watch item.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: MRO is a new capability with talks under way with large Indian companies and aftermarket work for Boeing and other US firms, with results expected mainly in Q3-Q4, but no specific product or service launch was named.

rows.label: Inventory reduction toward 4-month holding
rows.why: Inventory fell to 6.67 months from 7.98 months a year earlier, but still above the internal 4-month (three-turn) target set for about 24 months.

rows.label: Interest cost savings from INR300 crore raise
rows.why: Proceeds are partly used to repay working capital limits and management expects a visible interest cost saving from Q3 FY27, though the quantum was not given.

rows.label: Second global semicon customer onboarded
rows.why: The company now serves two large multinational semicon customers, and management expects a larger share of revenue from semicon in Q3-Q4.

tone.note: Management was confident on margins (18%-23% target), semicon growth and the Q3-Q4 ramp, but cautious in declining to quantify FY27 revenue or the interest saving; analysts pressed on the aerospace/non-aerospace split, FY27 guidance and the size of interest savings.
